```{r}
#| label: setup
#| output: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false
# Load the project's functions from the checkout (decision 0042) and read the
# published data bundle, so this code reproduces the figure (decision 0040).
root <- Sys.getenv("CFB2NFL_ROOT")
if (!nzchar(root)) root <- pkgload::pkg_path()
knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = root)
pkgload::load_all(root, quiet = TRUE)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggiraph)

con <- DBI::dbConnect(
  duckdb::duckdb(),
  file.path(root, "data", "cfb2nfl.duckdb"),
  read_only = TRUE
)
release <- data_release_date()
outcomes <- DBI::dbReadTable(con, "outcomes")
roster_pos <- DBI::dbGetQuery(
  con,
  "SELECT playerId, season, any_value(position) AS position FROM roster GROUP BY playerId, season"
)
endings <- career_endings(outcomes, roster_pos) |> label_endings()
state_fill <- ending_palette()
min_curve <- 30
# Seasons resting on fewer players are drawn grey: too few to read alone.
min_solid <- 100
```

```{r}
#| label: figure
qb_steps <- ending_hazards(endings) |>
  filter(group == "Quarterback", ending == "drafted", at_risk >= min_curve) |>
  transmute(time, at_risk, drafted = events, chance = hazard, solid = at_risk >= min_solid)

p <- ggplot(qb_steps, aes(factor(time), 100 * chance)) +
  geom_col_interactive(
    aes(
      tooltip = sprintf(
        "Season %d: %s of %s quarterbacks at risk drafted (%s)",
        time, fmt(drafted), fmt(at_risk), pct(chance)
      ),
      data_id = time,
      fill = solid
    ),
    width = 0.65
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(`TRUE` = state_fill[["Drafted"]], `FALSE` = "grey75"), guide = "none") +
  geom_text(
    aes(label = sprintf("%s / %s\n= %s", fmt(drafted), fmt(at_risk), pct(chance))),
    vjust = -0.2,
    size = 5,
    lineheight = 0.95
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = \(x) paste0(x, "%"), expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.3))) +
  labs(
    title = "Quarterbacks' per-season chance of being drafted",
    subtitle = sprintf(
      "Drafted that season out of the quarterbacks still in college going in; grey where fewer than %d",
      min_solid
    ),
    x = "Eligible season",
    y = "Chance that season",
    caption = card_caption(release)
  ) +
  theme_card()

card_thumbnail(p, "quarterback-drafted-chance", release = release)
card_interactive(p)
```

```{r}
#| label: risk-set-flow
# Each quarterback's state going into every eligible season: still playing
# (at risk) while his clock has not passed his last season, then the way his
# career ended, carried forward.
qb_last <- max(qb_steps$time)
flow_lab <- c(
  playing = "Playing",
  drafted = "Drafted",
  signed_udfa = "Signed undrafted",
  left_data = "Left the data",
  censored = "Still playing (censored)",
  exhausted_undrafted = "Eligibility ended, undrafted"
)
flow_colour <- c(
  playing = "#374151",
  drafted = state_fill[["Drafted"]],
  signed_udfa = state_fill[["Signed undrafted"]],
  exhausted_undrafted = state_fill[["Eligibility ended, undrafted"]],
  left_data = state_fill[["Left the data"]],
  censored = "#C4C8CE"
)
qb_states <- endings |>
  filter(group == "Quarterback", time > 0) |>
  select(playerId, time, ending) |>
  tidyr::expand_grid(axis = seq_len(qb_last + 1)) |>
  mutate(state = if_else(time >= axis, "playing", ending))
qb_links <- qb_states |>
  mutate(to = lead(state), .by = "playerId") |>
  filter(axis <= qb_last) |>
  count(axis, from = state, to) |>
  mutate(at_risk = sum(n[from == "playing"]), .by = "axis")
qb_nodes <- qb_states |>
  count(axis, state) |>
  mutate(state = factor(state, names(flow_lab))) |>
  arrange(axis, state) |>
  mutate(id = row_number() - 1L) |>
  mutate(y = (cumsum(n) - n / 2) / sum(n) * 0.9 + 0.05, .by = "axis") |>
  mutate(
    x = (axis - 1) / qb_last * 0.98 + 0.01,
    hover = sprintf(
      "%s %s, %s",
      fmt(n),
      tolower(flow_lab[state]),
      if_else(axis > qb_last, sprintf("after season %d", qb_last), sprintf("going into season %d", axis))
    )
  )
node_id <- function(axis, state) {
  qb_nodes$id[match(paste(axis, state), paste(qb_nodes$axis, qb_nodes$state))]
}
qb_links <- qb_links |>
  mutate(
    source = node_id(axis, from),
    target = node_id(axis + 1L, to),
    hover = case_when(
      from == "playing" & to == "playing" ~ sprintf("Season %d: %s of %s at risk played again the next season", axis, fmt(n), fmt(at_risk)),
      from == "playing" ~ sprintf("Season %d: %s of %s at risk (%s): %s", axis, fmt(n), fmt(at_risk), pct(n / at_risk), tolower(flow_lab[to])),
      TRUE ~ sprintf("%s %s before season %d", fmt(n), tolower(flow_lab[from]), axis + 1L)
    ),
    colour = paste0(
      flow_colour[if_else(from == "playing", to, from)],
      case_when(to == "playing" ~ "B3", to == "exhausted_undrafted" ~ "4D", TRUE ~ "99")
    )
  )
plotly::plot_ly(
  type = "sankey",
  arrangement = "fixed",
  node = list(
    label = if_else(qb_nodes$axis > qb_last, unname(flow_lab[as.character(qb_nodes$state)]), ""),
    x = qb_nodes$x,
    y = qb_nodes$y,
    color = unname(flow_colour[as.character(qb_nodes$state)]),
    customdata = qb_nodes$hover,
    hovertemplate = "%{customdata}<extra></extra>",
    pad = 12,
    thickness = 18,
    line = list(width = 0)
  ),
  link = list(
    source = qb_links$source,
    target = qb_links$target,
    value = qb_links$n,
    color = qb_links$colour,
    customdata = qb_links$hover,
    hovertemplate = "%{customdata}<extra></extra>"
  ),
  height = 560
) |>
  plotly::layout(
    title = list(
      text = paste0(
        "<b>How quarterbacks' college careers end, season by season</b><br>",
        "<span style='font-size:15px;color:#4B5563'>Quarterbacks still playing ",
        "(dark) flow into the next season or out to an ending; hover a flow for its count</span>"
      ),
      x = 0.01,
      font = list(size = 20)
    ),
    font = list(size = 15),
    margin = list(t = 110, b = 30, l = 30, r = 30)
  )
```
